root_cause: The hourly snapshot cron command calls set_config('statement_timeout','90000',true) inside a DO block. The timer of the running statement is not re-armed, so the effective limit stayed at the default 120 s. Over 14 days (2026-10-25 to 2026-11-08): 336 runs, 4 failed at about 120 s (1.2 percent); successful runs average about 60 s and reach 114 s. Related fingerprint powerhouse|revenue-snapshot|cron-120s-statement-timeout|v1.
prevention_rule: Arm statement_timeout as a separate statement before the DO block (set local statement_timeout = '240s'), keep the advisory lock and both functions, change nothing else. A required-check test pins the command shape. This does not make the snapshot faster; a structural fix still needs tenant parity and performance validation.
